title: fix(setup): land a member who may not read the activation ledger on an entry they can open, not on Packaged Actions
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DXuamRUC67fx2TTYrFfyuSH)_

Fixes #33224 — the Setup landing half (the navigation half is #33349). Route A, as the seat ruled.

Clause-②: no — the served `GET /meta/app/setup` tree is unchanged for every caller except that `nav_packaged_actions` now carries `visible: current_user.can('sys_metadata_activation', 'read')`, which the console asks with the member's `/auth/me/permissions` map. A member who may read the ledger is shown the entry and lands as before (the platform administrator still lands on System Overview). A member who may not read it stops being shown an entry whose page rendered only `activation ledger HTTP 403`; nothing they could use is withdrawn.
Metadata-protocol: none

## Maintainer quick read

- What changes: Setup's Packaged Actions entry is shown only to a member who may read the activation ledger its page reads. Everyone else lands on the first Setup entry they can open.
- Why: Packaged Actions is the first entry Setup serves, and the console's object-read prune judges `type: 'object'` entries only. So every member landed on it, including a separation-of-duties officer (an auditor holding `view_all_audit_log`) whose ledger read answers 403, and their Setup opened on `activation ledger HTTP 403`.
- Risk and rollback: low. Admins (who read the ledger) see the same menu and landing as before. The entry still carries no `requiredPermissions` and no `requiresService`; the activation write doors keep their server-side gates. Rollback is a revert.
- Read first: `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/setup-nav.contributions.ts` (the `visible` and its comment).
- Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run test/setup-landing-audience.pin.test.ts`; expect 4 green cases.
- Needed from you: nothing.

## What changes

- `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/setup-nav.contributions.ts` — `nav_packaged_actions` gains `visible: "current_user.can('sys_metadata_activation', 'read')"`. The console asks a nav entry's `visible` in both its sidebar and its landing walk (`AppRootLanding` → `findFirstRoute` over the tree `useNavMemberGates` gates, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx`), with `can` bound to `/auth/me/permissions` (pinned in ui/ by `UnifiedSidebar.navCanPermissions-12700.test.tsx`). No Setup entry used `can` before; HotCRM and `examples/app-crm` already do.
- `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/setup-packaged-actions-nav.test.ts` — the pin header no longer calls the entry deliberately ungated. It says the earlier "no audience" was a developer choice (#12491), not a ruling, and why the entry now carries the ledger-read audience. A new case pins the predicate exactly. The "no `requiresService`" and "no `requiredPermissions`" cases stay, with their reasons.
- `packages/platform-objects/src/system/sys-metadata-activation.object.test.ts` — the "no shipped app or nav names the ledger" pin now allows exactly this one predicate (a permission question no row changes) and still refuses any other mention.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/platform-objects` patch.

## Tests

- New `packages/cli/test/setup-landing-audience.pin.test.ts` (unit tier): composes `SETUP_APP`, `SETUP_NAV_CONTRIBUTIONS` and `AuditPlugin`'s contribution through the real `SchemaRegistry`, reads `GET /api/v1/meta/apps/setup` through the real `RestServer` route, and walks the served tree the way the console lands (groups walked, `url` skipped, first `object`/`page`/`dashboard`/`report`/`component` wins; `visible` asked with the real CEL engine and the member's object map; an `object` entry pruned without read on its object):
  - Packaged Actions is served with the predicate, and is still the first landing-type entry for the officer (so the predicate, not the order, moves the landing);
  - an officer holding `view_all_audit_log` who may read `sys_audit_log` and `sys_user` but not the ledger lands on `nav_users` (People & Org › Users);
  - the same served tree, with ledger read, lands on `nav_packaged_actions`;
  - the platform administrator still lands on `nav_system_overview` and is still shown Packaged Actions.

## Verification

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects exec vitest run`: 120 of 122 files green; the 2 failing cases are `object-collapsed-sections-echo-decisions.test.ts`, which fails identically on `origin/main` in this worktree (stale local build), so not this change.
- `packages/cli`: `setup-landing-audience`, `console-page-nav-entries`, `setup-integrations-order`, `i18n-contributed-nav-coverage`, `translation-contributed-nav-validate-door`: 5 files / 22 tests passed (`platform-objects` rebuilt first; the cli suite reads its `dist/`).
- Pre-push hooks passed.
